ruling_text:
The Court has read and considered the Motion For Partial Sealing
and Redaction of Defendant's Identifying Information by Chantel
Thomas Nguyen (ROA 54).

The Court finds that it is clear the Legislature intends to protect the
confidential address of victims of domestic violence (see
Government Code section 6205) and has set up procedures and
safeguards in order to not place domestic violence at additional
risk of harm or violence. On February 9, 2026, Ms. Thomas
Nguyen presented to the Court a domestic violence restraining
order protecting Ms. Thomas Nguyen from William Ryan, aka
William Ryan III, a named defendant in this matter.

The Court finds there exists an overriding interest in protecting the
safety of a victim of domestic violence, which overcomes the right
of the public to access the court records. The Court finds a
substantial probability exists that the overriding interest will be
prejudiced if the record is not sealed and there is no less restrictive
means that exist to achieve the overriding interest. The Court will
seal the Court's record of this case regarding all information
pertaining to Chantel Thomas Nguyen and her contact information
pursuant to California Rules of Court, Rule 2.550(d) - this includes
Ms. Thomas Nugyen's Answer (ROA 21), Order on Court Fee
Waiver (ROA 24), Clerk's Certificate of Mailing/Electronic
Service (ROA 34), Proof of Service by Mail (ROA 35), Ex Parte
Application for Continuance of Trial (ROA 36), Clerk's Certificate
of Mailing/Electronic Service (ROA 40), Clerk's Certificate of
Sealing and Redaction of Defendant's Identifying Information
(ROA 54).

The Court orders Chantel Thomas Nguyen's information be sealed
from the public index and online case search results, and her
address, phone number, and email address be redacted from all
documents in the court file and from any and all
publicly accessible records.

The Court orders that Ms. Thomas Nugyen's address, phone
number, and email address are not to be disclosed to any other
party absent an order from this Court due to safety concerns related
to domestic violence.
The Court Clerk is to be notified forthwith to comply with this
Court's order.
The Court Clerk is to provide notice.
